WITH film_counts AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id
),
first_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count
  FROM film_counts
),
first_pass AS (
  SELECT fc.film_id, fc.actor_count, fc.actor_count - a.avg_count AS excess_first
  FROM film_counts fc
  CROSS JOIN first_avg a
  WHERE fc.actor_count > a.avg_count
),
second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count
  FROM first_pass
),
remaining AS (
  SELECT fp.actor_count, fp.excess_first, fp.actor_count - a.avg_count AS excess_second
  FROM first_pass fp
  CROSS JOIN second_avg a
  WHERE fp.actor_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT SUM(actor_count) AS total_actor_count,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second
FROM remaining
